titulo: Following instructions from start to finish
intro: Read a continuous procedure and tell apart its steps, conditions and exceptions.
p.solicitud.consejo: It comes from «solicitar». You can «presentar» or «enviar» a solicitud.
p.adjuntar.consejo: The j sounds h: ad-hun-TAR. In an email, the «archivo adjunto» is the one you add.
p.domicilio.consejo: It is more formal than «casa» or «dirección». It is used in documents: «cambio de domicilio».
p.enviar.consejo: It has an accent in «envío» and «envías», but not in «enviamos». You send a parcel or an email.
p.confirmación.consejo: It comes from «confirmar». It ends in -ción: it has an accent and is feminine.
p.formulario.consejo: It is like an «impreso», but usually digital. You can «completar» or «rellenar» it.
p.a continuación.consejo: It marks the next step: «a continuación, adjunte el documento». It usually takes a comma.
p.por último.consejo: It closes a list of steps. «Último» has an accent: UL-ti-mo.
p.en caso de que.consejo: It takes the subjunctive: «en caso de que falte algo». With a noun, «en caso de» is enough.
p.salvo que.consejo: It marks an exception and takes the subjunctive: «salvo que lo pidan». The v sounds like b.
p.número de seguimiento.consejo: With it you follow your parcel. «Seguimiento» comes from «seguir».
p.atención al cliente.consejo: It is the service you call when you have a problem. A «cliente» is the person who buys.
b1.titulo: Follow the order and the exceptions
b1.texto:
Procedures combine ordered steps with conditions. **Primero**, **a continuación** and **por último** mark the order. **Si** and **en caso de que** introduce a condition; **salvo que** marks an exception. Before you start, check what you must **adjuntar** and what happens if the usual route does not work.

Instructions use the **usted** imperative: **complete**, **adjunte**, **guarde**, **llame**, **revise**, **envíe**.

This procedure is fictional and is meant for practice.
b2.f0.texto: I want to request a replacement card.
b2.f1.texto: First fill in the form on our website.
b2.f2.texto: Next, attach a copy of your ID.
b2.f4.texto: It is sent to your home address, unless you give another address.
b2.f5.texto: What happens if I cannot upload the file?
b2.f6.texto: Keep the tracking number and call customer service.
b2.f7.texto: Finally, check the details and send the request.
b2.f8.texto: When will I receive the confirmation?
b2.f9.texto: If anything is missing, we will contact you.
b4.texto:
A long instruction is easier to follow if you tell three things apart:

- **The order**: **primero**, **a continuación**, **después**, **por último** + usted imperative. **Complete**, **adjunte**, **guarde**, **llame**, **revise**, **envíe**.
- **The condition**: **si** + present, or **en caso de que** + subjunctive. **En caso de que falte algo, le avisaremos.**
- **The exception**: **salvo que** + subjunctive. **No envíe originales salvo que se los pidan.**

To give an order to «usted»: verbs in **-ar** end in **-e** (complete) and verbs in **-er** or **-ir**, in **-a** (escriba). The negative uses the same form: **no envíe**.
b4.e0.texto: First fill in the form and then attach a copy.
b4.e1.texto: If any document is missing, we will let you know.
b4.e2.texto: Do not send original documents unless they ask for them.
b5.f0.texto: Lucía follows the instructions on the screen step by step.
b5.f1.texto: First she writes her name in small, careful letters.
b5.f2.texto: Then she attaches a photo of the document with a sure click.
b5.f3.texto: The cursor blinks in the last box, next to the word address.
b5.f4.texto: A green light confirms that everything is in order.
b5.f5.texto: During the following days, Lucía checks the mailbox every morning.
b5.f6.texto: The white envelope finally appears among the neighbours' letters.
b5.f7.texto: Lucía opens the envelope slowly and reads the tracking number.
b5.f8.texto: Inside there is a new card that shines under the hallway light.
b5.f9.texto: Lucía smiles, puts the envelope in a drawer and writes the number in her diary.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It marks the step that comes next.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Sin embargo» marks a contrast, not a sequence.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Aunque» expresses a concession; here an order is needed.
b6.pregunta: Which connector introduces the next step?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Order is marked by «primero» or «por último».
b7.o1.refuerzo: That is it! «Salvo que» means «except if».
b8.frase: Primero complete el formulario y después adjunte el documento
b8.traduccion: First fill in the form and then attach the document
b9.o0.refuerzo: Well done! With it you know where your parcel is.
b9.o1.refuerzo: It does not change any password; it only tracks the shipment.
b9.o2.refuerzo: An identity document does that, not this number.
b9.pregunta: What is the tracking number for?
b10.frase: En caso de que ____ algún documento, le avisaremos.
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Falta» is the ordinary present. «En caso de que» takes the subjunctive.
b10.o1.refuerzo: The infinitive does not work after «que».
b10.o2.refuerzo: Yes! «En caso de que» asks for the subjunctive: «falte».
b10.pregunta: Which form follows «en caso de que»?
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Envía» is the order for «tú», not for «usted».
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Enviar» is the infinitive, not the «usted» command.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Well done! Verbs in -ar end in -e for «usted».
b12.pregunta: What is the order form for «usted» of «enviar»?
b13.frase: Se envía a su ____, salvo que indique otra dirección.
b13.o0.refuerzo: That is it! The «domicilio» is the address where you live.
b13.o1.refuerzo: The «solicitud» is the paper you send, not a place.
b13.o2.refuerzo: The «formulario» is the document you fill in, not an address.
p.reemplazo.consejo: Something that takes the place of another thing.
p.complete.consejo: From «completar», to fill in all of it.
p.adjunte.consejo: From «adjuntar», to attach a file. The «j» sounds like «h».
p.copia.consejo: A second version of the same paper.
p.identidad.consejo: Your ID shows who you are.
p.indique.consejo: From «indicar», to show or say which one.
p.seguimiento.consejo: Following a parcel to see where it is.
p.revise.consejo: From «revisar», to look at something carefully.
p.envíe.consejo: From «enviar», to send. The accent shows the stress.
p.recibiré.consejo: From «recibir», to receive. The future ends in «-ré».
p.avisaremos.consejo: Future of «avisar», to tell someone something.
p.originales.consejo: The first version, not a copy.
p.pidan.consejo: From «pedir», to ask for. Subjunctive form.
p.cuidadosas.consejo: Someone who takes care with small things.
p.cursor.consejo: The flashing mark on the screen.
p.confirma.consejo: From «confirmar», to say that something is true.
p.agenda.consejo: A notebook where you write appointments.
p.seguir.consejo: From «seguir», to follow. The «gu» becomes «g» before «i».
